question: What security and ownership boundary should the Dashboard browser preview use before implementation?
rationale: The panel would expose sensitive browser state and may be implemented as core Control UI or plugin-contributed UI; automation cannot safely choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Read-only-first admin panel
options.body: Add a first-party or approved plugin-contributed panel for tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs, while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credentials, and submits.

options.title: Wait for plugin UI entry points
options.body: Defer the browser-specific panel until the generic plugin UI entry-point contract is accepted and implement the surface as browser-plugin-owned UI.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the current CLI/RPC screenshot workflow until remote browser preview becomes a prioritized product area.

recommendation.title: Read-only-first admin panel
recommendation.body: Add a first-party or approved plugin-contributed panel for tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs, while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credentials, and submits.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from browser runtime, Control UI routing, and the existing issue discussion.
